name: flight-hunter
description: Find the cheapest or best-value flights for any trip, the way an obsessive human would: Google Flights (fli), Kiwi and Kayak, then the routes most people never check (wrong-city + hop, positioning to a cheaper gateway, self-transfers, ferries, group-size splits, point-of-sale pricing). Flags visas, bags and tight connections. Re-prices your finalists later with a trip watch. Search only - never books.

home_airports.title: Home airports
home_airports.description: IATA codes you usually fly from, comma-separated (e.g. LIS, or JFK,EWR,LGA). Leave blank to be asked each hunt.

passports.title: Passport nationalities
passports.description: Countries of the passports you travel on (e.g. Germany, or Uruguay,Italy). Used for visa and transit checks. Leave blank to be asked.

currency.title: Your currency
currency.description: Also show totals in this currency besides USD (e.g. EUR, BRL). Leave blank for USD only.

trips_dir.title: Trips folder
trips_dir.description: Where each hunt saves its folder (searches, results.csv, report.md, trip.json). Leave blank to use the folder Claude Code is running in.
